rows.name: North Carolina Health Information Technology Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises the Department of Health and Human Services on health information technology strategy, EHR interoperability, and North Carolina's statewide health information network.

rows.name: North Carolina Opioid and Substance Abuse Advisory Cabinet
rows.constituent: North Carolinians affected by substance use
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor on North Carolina's opioid and substance abuse response. Coordinates treatment, recovery, and harm reduction strategy across state agencies and federal programs.

rows.name: NC Commission for Mental Health, Developmental Disabilities & Substance Abuse Services
rows.constituent: North Carolinians with mental illness, DD, and SUD
rows.mandate: Advises the Department of Health and Human Services on policy and programs for North Carolinians with mental illness, developmental disabilities, and substance use disorders.

rows.name: Governor's Advisory Council on Hispanic/Latino Affairs
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor on policies and programs affecting North Carolina's Hispanic and Latino communities. Monitors equity in state services, language access, and economic inclusion.

rows.name: North Carolina Affordable Housing Advisory Committee
rows.mandate: Advises the NC Housing Finance Agency on affordable housing policy, federal HOME program priorities, and strategies to address the state's affordable housing shortage.

rows.name: Environmental Justice and Equity Advisory Board
rows.mandate: Advises the Department of Environmental Quality on environmental justice policy. Reviews the disproportionate environmental burden on low-income and communities of color across North Carolina.

rows.name: North Carolina Commission for Women
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor and General Assembly on issues affecting North Carolina women. Conducts research, monitors gender equity, and advocates for women's economic security, health, and safety.

rows.name: North Carolina Council on Developmental Disabilities
rows.mandate: Federally mandated DD Council that advocates for people with developmental disabilities in North Carolina. Develops the State DD Plan and promotes self-determination, integration, and inclusion.

rows.name: Criminal Justice Information Network Advisory Board
rows.mandate: Advises on North Carolina's statewide criminal justice information network. Oversees data governance, interoperability between law enforcement systems, and privacy compliance across agencies.

rows.name: North Carolina State Board of Education — At-Large Advisory Members
rows.mandate: Advises North Carolina's State Board of Education on curriculum standards, educator preparation, and federal education program compliance including Title I and IDEA.
